plan.name: Keep native ratification text literal
plan.summary: Export receipt.EscapeText(string) string from the existing receipt encoder, retain componentText as a delegating wrapper for its callers, and replace the factory's duplicate text escaping and autolink implementation with that shared API. Render native acceptance labels, assertions and all part/framework/file/selector values as HTML code elements with their raw contents escaped exactly once, keeping visible text and one table row per record even with mentions, issue references, backticks, pipes, backslashes, HTML, entity-looking text, quotes and assertion line endings; update native_proposal_accept_test.go to compare rendered identity text while retaining its rejection of raw

tests.name: TestSharedTextEscapingPreservesReceiptCompatibility
tests.says: The exported text encoder preserves visible text without Markdown, HTML, table breaks or GFM autolinks, and receipt rendering, JSON and legacy fingerprints stay compatible.

tests.name: TestNativeRatificationTableKeepsLiteralValuesAndContract
tests.says: Every native label, assertion and complete identity stays literal inside code context in exactly one table row, while sources, marker and saved-plan/lock values, hashes, provenance, prose and ratification commands stay unchanged.
